source: Federal Decree-Law No. 17 of 2025 · Ministry of Finance
headline: OLD TAX CREDITS
WITH THE FTA?

blocks.text: A credit balance must now be refunded or used within **5 years** of the end of its tax period.

items: **One-year window:** credits whose 5 years ended before 1 Jan 2026, or end during 2026
**Deadline:** **31 December 2026** to submit the refund request
**Found an error later?** A voluntary disclosure is allowed within **2 years** of the request
